subject: MAP: gating items & security rollup for Acme Finance procurement
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@acme.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, security@acme.com
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff - SOC 2 attestation + pen test scope

Rachel —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. Procurement asked me to follow up with a single list of gating items they need to close our deal by 2027-04-30. High level asks from Acme security/legal: SOC 2 attestation, signed DPA, proof of audit logs retention, and pen test scope & timeline. Can you send a one-page rollup with current owners and dates? Were preparing the internal purchase request and need this by EOD Friday.

- Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Procurement, Acme Finance
alex.moreno@acme.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@acme.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: gating items & security rollup for Acme Finance procurement

Alex —

Thanks, attaching a quick MAP rollup and owners below. Ive also linked the working MAP doc: https://drive.redwood.com/acme/map-v2 (editable by both teams). Major status notes at a glance:

- SOC 2: Redwood has an in-progress SOC 2 Type II audit; attestation expected 2027-05-20. Monica is the owner for evidence bundle and can provide interim SOC 2 scope statement immediately. (Attachment: SOC2-Attestation-Requested.pdf)
- DPA: Legal has redlined v2; Laura to confirm final signature ETA. (Attachment: DPA-redlines-v2.docx)
- Audit logs: We retain auth and admin logs for 12 months by default; Monica will deliver the retention matrix and sample export by 2027-04-07.
- Pen test: Scope draft attached; proposed window 2027-04-18 to 2027-04-22. Karthik to confirm vendor and remediation SLAs. (Attachment: pen-test-scope.xlsx)

Action items (short):
1) Monica to upload SOC 2 scope statement & evidence index — owner: monica_patel — due: 2027-04-07
2) Laura to review and confirm DPA redlines and sign-off path — owner: laura_bennett — due: 2027-04-06
3) Karthik to confirm pen-test vendor and remediation SLOs, update scope — owner: karthik_iyer — due: 2027-04-08
4) Dylan to prepare a short technical runbook extract for Acme security (audit log fields, TTLs, access controls) — owner: dylan_brooks — due: 2027-04-07

Ill follow up with a 15-minute sync invite for Thursday to walk Acme through the items if that helps.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0173

Attachment stubs: SOC2-Attestation-Requested.pdf, DPA-redlines-v2.docx, pen-test-scope.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@acme.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gating items & security rollup for Acme Finance procurement

Thanks Rachel. Quick status update from engineering/compliance:

- SOC 2 evidence index: I uploaded a scoped PDF to the shared Drive and attached a one-pager with the expected attestation date. Interim statement: Redwood has completed control testing for most operational controls; external auditor fieldwork scheduled for mid-May.
- Audit logs: See matrix in the Drive for retention and export samples. For procurement, a sample export in CSV can be produced.
- Access to logs for Acme reviewers requires an NDA + temporary viewer role; we can provide a read-only export for the procurement team.

Action confirmations:
- Monica: evidence bundle + sample audit export — due 2027-04-07 — attachment: SOC2-Attestation-Requested.pdf
- Dylan: runbook extract (fields + retention TTL) — due 2027-04-07

If Acme needs any specific log fields included, flag them here and Ill prioritize.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Principal Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Cc: legal@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gating items & security rollup for Acme Finance procurement

Alex / team —

Quick legal update on the DPA: I reviewed Acmes proposed changes and our counsel agreed to three commercial concessions (see attached redlines). We can accept the majority of the requests but need a short approval from Acme legal on section 7 (data deletion procedures) and section 12 (subprocessor notification). Proposed next steps:

- Acme legal to confirm section 7 language by 2027-04-08 (owner: legal@acme.com)
- Laura to circulate final DPA for e-sign once confirmation received — target 2027-04-09

If those timelines work for procurement, well aim to have the signed DPA in hand by 2027-04-10, which keeps us on the MAP closing by 2027-04-30.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2027-04-09T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gating items & security rollup for Acme Finance procurement

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. A few quick confirmations from Acme:

- We can accept the interim SOC 2 scope statement for procurement purposes, and procurement will accept the CSV audit-export sample.
- Acme legal will review sections 7 and 12 and aim to respond by 2027-04-08 (theyre a bit delayed; expect reply tomorrow).
- For pen test, security@acme.com asked that vendor remediation SLA be no more than 14 days for critical findings; please confirm.

Rachel — can we lock a brief sync on Monday 2027-04-12 to confirm final DPA path and confirm the pen test vendor SLA? If Acme legal signs off on the two DPA sections quickly well proceed with procurement approval next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Alex
